metadata.title: The Velocity Distribution of Hypervelocity Stars

notes: No eligible star-level entries: the paper is a statistical/model study and provides no individual star identifiers. Its observational comparison uses an unnamed sample of about 18 unbound HVSs (T:p25-b2), and S-stars are mentioned only as a population/class (T:p2-b2), not as individually identified Galactic unbound candidates.
